featured.title: Smart Study Assistant
featured.tagline: AI-powered study platform that transforms notes into summaries, quizzes, and interactive learning experiences.
featured.summary: AI-powered study platform that transforms notes into summaries, quizzes, and interactive learning experiences. Built with Next.js, Supabase, and Gemini AI to enable automated note summarization, active recall flashcards, role-based access control, and persistent study history tracking.
highlights: Automated note summarisation and quiz generation
Role-based access control and persistent study history

featured.title: TabbyFund
featured.tagline: Full-stack platform that streamlines stray cat rescue through role-based workflows connecting communities, veterinarians, and adopters.
featured.summary: Full-stack platform that streamlines stray cat rescue through role-based workflows connecting communities, veterinarians, and adopters. Features multi-role access control for rescuers, vets, and adopters, real-time request tracking, adoption status management, and persistent database storage.
highlights: Multi-role user workflows for rescuers, vets, and adopters
Real-time adoption request tracking and status updates

featured.title: Smart Notes
featured.tagline: Modern desktop note-taking application featuring real-time search, categories, and automatic local data persistence.
featured.summary: Modern desktop note-taking application featuring real-time search, categories, and automatic local data persistence. Built using Java, JavaFX, and Gson to provide high-performance local text search, categorical organization, customized markdown rendering, and automated file-system persistence.
highlights: Instant local full-text search across all notes
Category management with automated JSON persistence

Features an object-oriented portfolio calculation engine, real-time transaction logging, asset distribution tracking, and clean browser dashboard UI powered by Spark framework.
highlights: Full CRUD transaction logging and performance tracking
